why: Screen annotation needs Wayland: a layer-shell overlay, and on Hyprland its Shift bindings. The X11 desktop that records A and C in real time cannot run it; Mluva itself says so there ('Screen annotation needs a Wayland desktop; this recording continues without it.').

No lossless 60 fps recorder exists here for a Wayland desktop. wf-recorder is not installed; gpu-screen-recorder needs a GPU or portal capture and encodes lossily; grim manages a few frames a second at 4K, enough for B's stepped clock but not for a real-time take. Building a compositor or recorder from downloaded source was not approved for this run.

The Hyprland VM from the annotation checks (tmp/hyprland-vm in the main checkout) still has its disk, but not its SSH key, and its Mluva is a debug build of 189f948, before #120 and #122. Re-provisioning it and filming through QMP screendumps would not give 60 fps either.
to_film_it: Install wf-recorder (a system package), then record docs/verification/screen-annotations/offscreen/run.sh's journey inside launch-video/launch/capture/sway_session.sh at 3840x2160, scale 2; or provision the Hyprland VM again with main's build and record inside the guest.
